old: The [canonical Aion house](../../../sources/psychology/jung/jung-1978-aion-cw9-2/SOURCE.md) selects the **1978 corrected printing of the second edition**, but contains no acquired passage cards. Its metadata and prose also disagree about the discoverability of an external local copy. This companion therefore adds no page or paragraph number and no purported Jung quotation. Exact passage recovery is a remaining source task, rather than a reason to erase the already admitted interpretive branch.
new: The [canonical Aion house](../../../sources/psychology/jung/jung-1978-aion-cw9-2/SOURCE.md#passages) retains the selected **1978 corrected hardcover printing** and now records sixteen contextual paraphrase locations from the actual **1979 paperback reading carrier**. AION-P06 identifies VII, §§150–154, pp. 95–97 for the sixteenth-century schism and outward turn; AION-P12 identifies XII, §§267–271, pp. 173–174 for alchemy, science and the later faith/knowledge division. These consulted locations make this branch recoverable. Collation against the selected printing and verification of any proposed quotation remain Open; neither is claimed by this passage map. Jung’s historical-psychological interpretation remains distinct from independent causal history.
